---
title: "Composing steps"
---

* Steps operate on the output of the previous step.
* There are some useful dynamics Emil mentioned.

E.g.

```python
rec = (
    Recipe(data=df, outcome="label", predictors=[...])
    .add(StepDummy(s.nominal_predictors()))
    .add(StepNormalize(s.has_source(step_type=StepDummy)))
)
```
